exposure: ADSL gene variants (known pathogenic and variant of uncertain significance)
cohort: An infant who died at 52 days of age with clinical features suggestive of severe epileptic encephalopathy and leukodystrophy of unknown cause.
finding: This case report identifies vacuolating leukodystrophy as a novel feature of adenylosuccinase deficiency and demonstrates the utility of anticipatory banking of biological samples for achieving accurate diagnoses in individuals with undiagnosed disorders.
